name: efficient-ai
description: Same quality, fewer tokens: structure-aware code reading (outline), lossless output compression (squeeze), and session token attribution (tokscope).

interface.shortDescription: Cut agent session tokens and API cost without losing quality
interface.longDescription: Provides tokscope (session token & prompt-cache profiler), outline (structure-aware file & symbol reader), squeeze (lossless spill-to-file output wrapper), and token-budgeted coding policies.
defaultPrompt: Audit my static prefix and session token usage with tokscope.
Use outline to explore large files before reading them in full.
